[00:00] Client: I can't log into my account portal, it keeps saying error.
[00:05] Agent: What error.
[00:07] Client: It just says 'session expired' every time.
[00:11] Agent: Clear your browser cache.
[00:14] Client: Um, okay, how do I-
[00:16] Agent: Settings, clear browsing data. Do it.
[00:35] Client: Okay done, and... it let me in now.
[00:40] Agent: There you go.
[00:42] Client: Okay. Thanks I guess.
[00:45] Agent: Mmhm.
